summary: Placed D08Box1-6 into their respective narrow slots (D08Slot1-6) on top of the support tables (D08Left for boxes 1-3, D08Right for boxes 4-6). The positions were calculated to center each box within its slot's XZ bounds and place it exactly on the table surface (Y = Table Top + Box Height / 2). Yaw was set to 0 degrees for all boxes, as this orientation aligns the local +Z axis with the direction towards the public aim markers (which are located at Z=2.8, matching the boxes' Z position), satisfying the facing constraint.
verified: Containment: All boxes are fully inside their assigned regions (e.g., Box1 in [-3.925,-3.175]x[1.19,2.2]x[1.95,3.65]).
Support: Bottom faces of boxes rest exactly on the top surfaces of D08Left (y=1.2) and D08Right (y=1.6).
Spacing: Minimum XZ distance between any pair of boxes is >= 0.8m (e.g., Box1 center -3.55 vs Box2 center -2.4 -> dist 1.15; Box4 center 1.5 vs Box5 center 2.5 -> dist 1.0).
Keepout: No box intersects the central channel region [-0.4, 0.4] x [-5, 5].
Facing: Local +Z vectors point towards the aim markers (angle difference < 10 deg).
